problem_description: Duplication of UI formatting rules, currency formatting, and percentage calculations across inline JavaScript in dashboard.html, executive_dashboard.html, and copilot.html.
root_cause: Independent creation of Auditor, Executive, and Copilot dashboards in prior iterations without a unified UI static utility module.
strategy: Extract and unify currency, percentage, and number formatting into a shared, robust static module (frontend/shared/financial-formatter.js and static/js/financial-formatter.js), and update templates/dashboard.html, templates/executive_dashboard.html, and templates/copilot.html to consume the unified formatting functions without altering UI designs or visual contracts.
rollback_strategy: git checkout -- templates/dashboard.html templates/executive_dashboard.html templates/copilot.html api/api.py && rm -rf static/js/financial-formatter.js frontend/shared/financial-formatter.js
